scripts.bench: pnpm run generate:ast-cache && node scripts/run-bench.ts && pnpm run readme
scripts.build: pnpm run build:zig && pnpm run build:rust
scripts.build:zig: cd zig && zig build --release=fast && mkdir -p ../bin && cp ./zig-out/bin/zig ../bin/zig
scripts.build:rust: cd rust && cargo build --release && mkdir -p ../bin && cp ./target/release/rust_parsers ../bin/rust
scripts.update-parsers: cd rust && cargo update && cd .. && cd zig && zig fetch --save git+https://github.com/yuku-toolchain/yuku/#HEAD
scripts.preflight: pnpm run generate:ast-cache && ./bin/rust --preflight files/typescript.js files/checker.ts files/lib.dom.d.ts files/react.js && ./bin/zig --preflight files/typescript.js files/checker.ts files/lib.dom.d.ts files/react.js
